keySentence: Jack traded the cow for beans.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The man had beans. "Trade for beans," he said. Jack wanted the beans. Jack traded the cow for beans.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The old man had small beans in his hand. "These are good beans," he said. Jack looked at them. He wanted the beans. Jack traded the cow for beans.
facts.Word cards: bean = 콩 / for = ~을 위해 / exchange = 교환하다 / cow = 소
